privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Journi (the "app", "we") respects your privacy. This policy explains what data the app processes, why it is used, and what data we do not collect.

sections.p: Journi stores your journal entries, streak data, freezes, and other basic progress information locally on your device. The content of your journal entries is not sent to our servers and is not used for analytics.

Journi uses Google Firebase Analytics to collect statistics about the use of the app's main features. We may collect events related to creating and saving journal entries, abandoning an entry, using and restoring freezes, breaking and reaching streak milestones, and interacting with notifications. These events may contain technical or aggregated parameters needed to analyze user behavior and how the app's features are used. The content of journal entries, their text, or any other data derived from their content is not sent to Firebase Analytics. Firebase Analytics may also automatically collect certain technical information about app usage as part of the Firebase service.

Journi uses Firebase Crashlytics to detect and analyze crashes and technical errors in the app. Crashlytics may process technical information related to a crash, including device model, operating system, app version, error timestamp, stack traces, and technical identifiers needed to analyze crashes. We do not use Crashlytics to collect or analyze the content of journal entries.

Journi uses Google Firebase services for analytics and crash reporting: Firebase Analytics is used to analyze app usage, while Firebase Crashlytics is used to detect and analyze crashes. Firebase is a third-party service, so relevant technical information may be processed through Google's infrastructure in accordance with its privacy policies. Journi does not use advertising and does not share journal entry content with third-party services.

The app may request permission to send local push notifications as reminders to write a journal entry. Notification permissions are used to provide these reminders. Interactions with notifications may also be recorded in Firebase Analytics as an aggregated event without sending the content of journal entries.

Journi does not send the text of journal entries, individual words or phrases from entries, journal content in any other form, or data derived from the content of entries to Firebase or other third-party services. We also do not require an account to use the main features of the app.

Journi's main data — journal entries, streaks, freezes, and other locally stored statistics — are stored on your device. Uninstalling the app removes locally stored data unless it has been retained by the operating system or another system backup mechanism. Data that has already been sent to Firebase for analytics or crash reporting is retained and deleted according to the policies and retention periods of the respective services.
Journi is not intended for individuals under the age of 13 and does not knowingly collect data from children.
We may update this policy when the app's features, data processing practices, or third-party services change. The date of the latest update is always shown at the beginning of this page.
